scope: Three hero design mockups for review; no live website changes

variants.name: Светлая консультация
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished desktop website hero design mockup for the fictional Russian dental clinic «Люм.», landscape 1440 by 900 composition. Show the designed webpage itself edge-to-edge, no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective. Input Image 1 is ONLY the exact product reference: keep this same pearly white two-root molar, its silhouette, viewing angle and glossy enamel. Its transparent background is not part of the design. The tooth must stay horizontally centered at exactly 50% of the page. Keep the entire tooth visible and visually dominant.
CRITICAL TYPOGRAPHY: compact, calm heading, only 36–42px equivalent at 1440px viewport, NEVER oversized, NEVER a giant headline spanning the page. All text in normal sentence case. Body text 16–17px, legible, restrained. Small header wordmark about 28px. No huge type behind the tooth. Strong professional spacing, coherent alignment and authentic Russian Cyrillic typography.
Common header: restrained white bar about 84px high, small cyan asterisk-style mark and wordmark «Люм.» on the left; ordinary text links «Услуги» and «Отзывы» towards right, a compact dark navy «Меню» button, and small «RU  EN» language control on the far right. Main palette ice blue, white, dark teal navy, one vivid orange primary action. Do not invent reviews, ratings, years of experience, addresses, phone numbers or statistics. No people, no stock photos, no splashes, no blue liquid coating. No floating glass cards, no glow, no large shadows, no gradients, no decorative icons over feature cards, no numbered labels. This is a considered contemporary dental website design, not an advertising poster.

Art direction: a calm balanced consultation layout. Below the white header, use a full uninterrupted very pale icy blue field #E7F7FE. Tooth at x=720, y=490, about 450px tall. Main three-part composition with a compact left text block at x=80, width=300px, vertically around y=320; tooth in the middle; a quiet text-only treatment navigator at x=1090, width=270px, around the same vertical level. Give the tooth generous breathing room, keep side content aligned.
Heading face Inter medium, 42px, navy. Exact two-line heading: «Стоматология» / «для всей семьи». Supporting paragraph at 17px: «Лечение, профилактика и восстановление зубов. Начнём с консультации.» One orange rounded button below the paragraph with exact label «Выбрать услугу» and a small diagonal arrow. Right navigator consists of four plain text links at comfortable 19px with generous vertical spacing: «Гигиена и лечение», «Имплантация», «Виниры и эстетика», «Исправление прикуса». No boxes around those links. Below the tooth a tiny but readable interaction caption «Потяните зуб — рассмотрите со всех сторон» with a discreet drag symbol. Bottom right small unobtrusive pause/reset controls. The blue field should feel soft and spacious, and the headline must remain smaller than one tenth of the tooth height.

Art direction: architectural white atlas. Clean white page, interrupted only by a central flat icy blue #E0F4FD vertical band approximately 450px wide, x=495 to 945, from below the header almost to the bottom. No border or shadow on the band. The same tooth is horizontally centered on the band and whole page at x=720, y=465, about 420px tall. Most copy sits near the upper outer corners rather than beside the middle of the tooth.
Upper left at x=70 y=150 compact two-line heading in Unbounded medium 500, only 36px: «Стоматология,» / «в которой всё понятно». Left heading block around 390px wide. Orange action below at x=70 y=285: «Начать с консультации». Upper right x=1050 y=170, body Inter 16px, around 280px wide: «От первого вопроса до понятного плана лечения.»
Along the bottom of the hero at y=775 put an open horizontal treatment navigator with four evenly spaced plain text links, outside any cards: «Лечение зубов», «Имплантация», «Эстетика улыбки», «Исправление прикуса». A little arrow may follow each link. Under the tooth, inside the band at y=715, a compact caption «Рассмотрите зуб со всех сторон». The effect is structured architectural fields, quiet typography and a clear central object. Avoid giant Unbounded lettering: the heading occupies a small corner, under 10% of the image area.

Art direction: a sophisticated enamel studio. Keep the common white header. Beneath it a broad solid dark teal navy field #123C50 from y=84 to y=665, followed by a pale icy blue lower field #E7F7FE from y=665 to bottom. Horizontally centered at x=720, position the same tooth at y=485, height about 450px, so its roots cross the boundary into the lighter lower field by roughly 50px. No platform, no ellipse, no pedestal.
At upper left x=80 y=170, compact two-line white PT Serif regular heading at 42px: «Лечение зубов» / «с понятным планом». At upper right x=1080 y=180, white Inter body at 17px: «Обсудим ваши вопросы, варианты лечения и следующие шаги.» Beneath it, one orange rounded button labelled «Записаться на консультацию». The heading must be modest, book-like and elegant, not oversized or poster typography.
In the lower light-blue field place three plain spacious navigation paths around y=790: «Сохранить зубы», «Изменить улыбку», «Восстановить зубы», with small functional arrows. Place a small interaction hint directly beneath the roots, before the lower navigation. The tooth remains dominant and centered, contrasting against deep blue and extending across the two colour fields. No extra panels or cards.
